function.name: complete_diallel_analysis
function.description: Performs Griffing's Half-Diallel Analysis to estimate General Combining Ability (GCA) and Specific Combining Ability (SCA). Fits a mixed model to pool parental variances, extracts BLUPs, and generates a heatmap visualization.

dataset_path.description: File path to the diallel cross data CSV in long format.

rep_var.description: Column name containing Replication or Block identifiers.

resp_var.description: Column name containing the response/trait variable (e.g., Yield).

trait_name.description: Human-readable name of the trait used for plot titles. Default is 'Trait'.

function.name: sim_multistage_field
function.description: Simulates yield data with customizable genetic and environmental correlation structures for multi-stage field trials.

batch_years.description: A JSON-formatted string mapping batch names to lists of years tested. Example: '{"2014": [2018, 2019], "2015": [2019, 2020]}'.

n_crosses.description: Number of distinct bi-parental families (crosses) generated per batch.

n_lines.description: Total number of individual progeny lines tested across the entire batch.

n_env.description: Number of distinct testing environments utilized per year.

n_rep.description: Number of replications (blocks) for each line within a specific year-location combo.

function.name: tetraploid_ml_pred
function.description: Predictive Machine Learning wrapper for Tetraploid Potato Genomic Data. Uses Genotype and Phenotype data to train predictive models like Ridge, RandomForest, or GBLUP.

geno_path.description: File path to the raw genotype CSV.

pheno_path.description: File path to the raw phenotype CSV.

env.description: Environment to filter the phenotype data by (e.g., 'Hancock20').

model_type.description: The specific machine learning model architecture to use.

genetic_model.description: The genetic encoding model to apply to the genotype data.

function.name: generate_gge_biplot
function.description: Performs Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) on environment-centered data to generate a GGE Biplot for genotype-by-environment analysis.

dataset_path.description: File path to the trial dataset CSV in wide format (Genotypes as rows, Environments as columns).

gen_col.description: The column name containing the Genotype identifiers.
